Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 15
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the New York Times source, conflating the article’s publication date (Nov. 13, 1977) with the actual election date. The NYT article explicitly states “NEW ORLEANS, Nov. 12 — Ernest N. Morial was elected Mayor of New Orleans today,” indicating the election occurred on Nov. 12, 1977. This misinterpretation led the team toward the wrong date despite multiple sources pointing to Nov. 12.
